'''Cleroff''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[King/Legends|king]] of half of a [[Technology-deficient planet|technologically-inept]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was the brother of [[Marius]] who served as his [[Vizier/Legends|vizier]], and the father of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Risa]].
